📺 Doc (2025–Present)

Doc follows Dr. Amy Larsen, a brilliant and highly respected physician whose life changes dramatically after a devastating car accident leaves her with severe memory loss. When she wakes up, Amy discovers that she has lost eight years of memories, including important moments involving her family, friends, relationships, and medical career. Suddenly forced to rebuild her life, she returns to the hospital where she once worked, only to discover that her colleagues and loved ones have complicated histories with her that she can no longer remember. As she struggles to regain her confidence and reconnect with the people around her, Amy must confront painful truths about her past while proving that she still has what it takes to save lives. Starring Molly Parker, the series delivers emotional medical drama, complicated relationships, and inspiring moments about resilience, forgiveness, second chances, and rediscovering yourself.

🎭 Genre: Medical Drama • Mystery • Drama

⭐ IMDb: 7.3/10

⏱️ Runtime: Approximately 43 minutes per episode • TV-14

🎥 Developed By: Barbie Kligman

📚 Based On: The Italian medical drama Doc – Nelle tue mani

📺 Where to Watch: FOX and Hulu in the United States.
